scope.question: Whether the 2015 PUF's mixed reported FLPDYR values leave its statistical reference period unknown.
scope.answer: No. The publisher documents an explicit substitution convention; the statistical reference period is Tax Year 2015 while each reported accounting period is preserved verbatim.
scope.resolves: A narrower question than complete PUF scientific admission.
scope.reading_note: Documentary facts carry basis publisher_documented. The modeling convention is a proposal and is labelled separately.

statistical_reference_period.publisher_statement: The records found in this file are intended to represent all returns filed for Tax Year 2015.
statistical_reference_period.substitution_convention: Returns for prior years were used in place of 2015 returns received and processed after December 31, 2016.
does_not_establish: Not proof that every amount was earned in 2015.
Not proof that the amounts on prior-year returns were restated into 2015 prices.
Not permission to repair or overwrite any reported accounting-period token.

reported_period_preservation.rule: Preserve each delivered token exactly as delivered.

convention.label: proposed_modeling_convention
convention.description: Preserve the publisher's 2015 statistical baseline when constructing a later-year donor distribution, applying a reviewed 2015-to-target statistical growth index to eligible source amounts without first applying another row-specific inflation factor.
convention.treats: The publisher's earlier-return substitutions as part of the delivered 2015 baseline.
